scenarios.title: Reconnecting with an old friend
scenarios.summary: Greet a friend you have not seen in years, catch up, and suggest meeting again.
scenarios.opening_line: Hey! Wow, it has been ages. How have you been?
goals: Greet warmly and use the friend's name
Share one or two recent updates about yourself
Ask at least one question about the friend's life
Suggest a specific time to meet again
hints: It is so good to see you. How have you been?
I have been busy with university. What have you been up to?
Would you like to get coffee next week?

scenarios.title: Starting a conversation at work
scenarios.summary: Make small talk with a colleague during a break without it feeling forced.
scenarios.opening_line: Hi. Did you get a chance to try the new cafeteria menu?
goals: Respond to the colleague's question
Give a short answer or opinion
Ask one follow-up question
Close the conversation politely
hints: Yes, I tried it. What did you think of it?
I liked the soup. Have you tried it yet?
Thanks for the tip. I hope to see you at lunch.

scenarios.title: Ordering at a busy café
scenarios.summary: Order a drink and a snack when the queue is long and the staff are busy.
scenarios.opening_line: Hi, welcome! What can I get for you today?
goals: State the order clearly
Ask one question about an item
Confirm the total before paying
Say thank you and step aside
hints: I would like a medium latte, please.
What is in the chicken sandwich?
Could you tell me the total, please?

scenarios.title: Asking a neighbour for a favour
scenarios.summary: Ask a neighbour for a small favour, accept a no gracefully, and say thank you.
goals: Introduce yourself by name if needed
Explain the request in one or two sentences
Accept a no politely
Thank the neighbour
hints: Hi, I am your neighbour from the next flat. I have a small favour to ask.
Would it be possible to borrow your ladder for an hour?
No problem at all. Thank you for considering it.

scenarios.title: Responding to a rude remark from a stranger
scenarios.summary: Stay calm and respond to an unkind comment without escalating or withdrawing.
scenarios.opening_line: Honestly, some people just do not know how to queue.
goals: Pause before responding
Acknowledge the comment without arguing
Say something brief and neutral
Leave the situation if you feel unsafe
hints: I hear you. Let us all get through the line.
I am not going to argue about it. Have a good day.
If it keeps going, I will step away.

scenarios.title: Joining a family gathering
scenarios.summary: Join a relative's gathering, answer questions about your life, and step away when you need a break.
scenarios.opening_line: There you are! Come and sit. We were just talking about you.
goals: Greet each relative
Answer a question about your studies or work
Change the topic if a question feels too personal
Ask to step out for a short break
hints: Hello, it is good to see everyone. How is the family?
I am studying computer science at the moment. It keeps me busy.
Would you excuse me for a few minutes? I will be right back.
